CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bot_users (
    telegram_chat_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    location geometry(Point, 4326) NOT NULL,
    location_shared_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT bot_users_latitude_ck
        CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
    CONSTRAINT bot_users_longitude_ck
        CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
);

    ON bot_users USING GIST (location);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bot_events (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,

    event_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    fuel_code TEXT REFERENCES fuel_products(code),
    result_count INTEGER,
    metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::JSONB,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CONSTRAINT bot_events_result_count_ck
        CHECK (result_count IS NULL OR result_count >= 0),

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dashboard_daily_metrics AS
SELECT
    timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE AS metric_date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT telegram_chat_id) AS active_users,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE event_name = 'start_command'
    ) AS starts,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE event_name = 'location_shared'
    ) AS locations_shared,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE event_name = 'fuel_search'
    ) AS fuel_searches,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE event_name = 'fuel_search'
          AND result_count > 0
    ) AS successful_searches,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE event_name = 'unrecognized_message'
    ) AS unrecognized_messages
FROM bot_events
GROUP BY timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dashboard_fuel_metrics AS
SELECT
    timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE AS metric_date,
    fuel_code,
    COUNT(*) AS searches,
    COUNT(DISTINCT telegram_chat_id) AS unique_users,
    ROUND(AVG(result_count), 2) AS average_results
FROM bot_events
WHERE event_name = 'fuel_search'
  AND fuel_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE,
    fuel_code;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dashboard_event_metrics AS
SELECT
    timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE AS metric_date,
    event_name,
    COUNT(*) AS events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT telegram_chat_id) AS unique_users
FROM bot_events
GROUP BY
    timezone('America/Lima', created_at)::DATE,
    event_name;

SELECT *
FROM dashboard_daily_metrics
ORDER BY metric_date DESC
LIMIT 30;

        s.latitude,
        s.longitude,

        ROUND(
            (
                ST_Distance(
                    s.location::geography,
                    u.location::geography
                ) / 1000
            )::NUMERIC,
            2
        ) AS distance_km,

        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'code', sc.code,
                'label', sc.label,
                'icon', sc.icon,
                'price', ss.price,
                'details', ss.details,
                'verified_at', ss.verified_at,
                'expires_at', ss.expires_at,
                'source_type', ss.source_type
            )
            ORDER BY sc.sort_order
        ) AS services

    FROM usuario u
    JOIN stations s
        ON s.location IS NOT NULL

    JOIN station_services ss
        ON ss.station_id = s.id
       AND ss.is_available = TRUE
       AND (
            ss.expires_at IS NULL
            OR ss.expires_at >= NOW()
       )

    JOIN service_catalog sc
        ON sc.code = ss.service_code
       AND sc.active = TRUE

    WHERE $2::TEXT = 'SERVICES'

    GROUP BY
        s.id,
        s.trade_name,
        s.brand,
        s.address,
        s.district,
        s.latitude,
        s.longitude,
        s.location,
        u.location

    ORDER BY s.location <-> u.location
    LIMIT 5
),

promociones_cercanas AS (
    SELECT
        s.id AS station_id,
        s.trade_name,
        s.brand,
        s.address,
        s.district,
        s.latitude,
        s.longitude,

        ROUND(
            (
                ST_Distance(
                    s.location::geography,
                    u.location::geography
                ) / 1000
            )::NUMERIC,
            2
        ) AS distance_km,

        so.id AS offer_id,
        so.title,
        so.description,
        so.promo_code,
        so.audience,
        so.valid_from,
        so.valid_until,
        so.promotional_price,
        so.discount_percent,
        so.terms_and_conditions,
        so.verified_at,
        so.source_type,

        oc.code AS offer_category_code,
        oc.label AS offer_category_label,
        oc.icon AS offer_category_icon

    FROM usuario u
    JOIN stations s
        ON s.location IS NOT NULL

    JOIN station_offers so
        ON so.station_id = s.id
       AND so.status = 'ACTIVE'
       AND (
            so.valid_from IS NULL
            OR so.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE
       )
       AND (
            so.valid_until IS NULL
            OR so.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE
       )

    JOIN offer_categories oc
        ON oc.code = so.offer_category_code
       AND oc.active = TRUE

    WHERE

            AND so.audience = 'GENERAL'
        )
        OR
        (
            $2::TEXT = 'TAXI_OFFERS'
            AND so.audience = 'TAXISTA'
        )

    ORDER BY s.location <-> u.location
    LIMIT 5

            'kind', 'OFFER',
            'station_id', station_id,
            'trade_name', trade_name,
            'brand', brand,
            'address', address,
            'district', district,
            'latitude', latitude,
            'longitude', longitude,
            'distance_km', distance_km,
            'offer_id', offer_id,
            'title', title,
            'description', description,
            'promo_code', promo_code,
            'audience', audience,
            'valid_from', valid_from,
            'valid_until', valid_until,
            'promotional_price', promotional_price,
            'discount_percent', discount_percent,
            'terms_and_conditions', terms_and_conditions,
            'verified_at', verified_at,
            'source_type', source_type,
            'offer_category_code', offer_category_code,
            'offer_category_label', offer_category_label,
            'offer_category_icon', offer_category_icon
        ) AS item
    FROM promociones_cercanas
)

SELECT
    (
        SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM usuario
        )
    ) AS has_location,

    $1::BIGINT AS telegram_chat_id,
    $2::TEXT AS totem_option,

    COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS result_count,

    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            item
            ORDER BY distance_km
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS items

FROM resultados;
